description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class responsible for managing voice communication features within an iOS app. It handles speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis using external providers, push-to-talk functionality, and integrates with a gateway for chat interactions. The class manages state, permissions, and audio sessions, and provides methods for controlling and monitoring voice input/output workflows.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container to hold errors encountered during stream processing, providing synchronized access.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Associates a gateway session with the TalkModeManager for message exchanges.

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates internal state based on gateway connection status and triggers starting recognition if appropriate.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and updates the main session key used for chat interactions and manages subscriptions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode and manages starting/stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins listening for microphone input, with permission requests and audio session configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening, cancels recognition, and deactivates audio session.

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone usage without fully disabling talk mode.

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Restores microphone functionality after background suspend.

methods.name: userTappedOrb
methods.description: Handles user interaction with an orb (likely UI element), stopping speech output.

methods.name: beginPushToTalk
methods.description: Initiates a push-to-talk session, requesting permissions and configuring audio for speech input.

methods.name: endPushToTalk
methods.description: Ends a push-to-talk session, processing the transcript and managing state accordingly.

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce
methods.description: Performs a single push-to-talk cycle with a maximum duration.

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing push-to-talk session.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts the speech recognition engine with audio tap and input setup.

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError
methods.description: Attempts to restart speech recognition after transient errors.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops and cleans up speech recognition tasks and audio taps.

methods.name: makeAudioTapAppendCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback for handling audio buffers tapped from the input node during recognition.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles partial and final speech transcripts, triggering processing or interruptions.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins a background task to monitor audio silence and trigger transcript processing.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks timing since last audio activity to determine if processing should be triggered due to silence.

methods.name: schedulePTTTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout for push-to-talk sessions to auto-terminate after a specified duration.

methods.name: handlePTTTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout expiry for push-to-talk, ending the session.

methods.name: finishPTTOnce
methods.description: Resumes push-to-talk completion handler with given payload.

methods.name: processTranscript
methods.description: Processes recognized speech, manages state transitions, and triggers chat interactions.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat events for a session key if not already subscribed.

methods.name: unsubscribeAllChats
methods.description: Removes all chat subscriptions.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a prompt string for chat based on the transcript.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the gateway and returns a run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatCompletion
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for chat completion status, with a timeout.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for assistant reply text after a chat message, with timeout.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches the most recent assistant message content since a timestamp.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Converts assistant text into speech, handling TTS via external provider or fallback.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops current speech output; can store interruption info.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines whether ongoing speech should be interrupted by new recognized speech.

methods.name: applyDirective
methods.description: Applies voice or model directives from an intent or instruction.

methods.name: resetIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Resets incremental speech buffers and states.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Cancels ongoing incremental speech tasks and resets relevant states.

methods.name: enqueueIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Adds text segments to the incremental speech queue for TTS rendering.

methods.name: startIncrementalSpeechTask
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task to process incremental speech segments.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Cancels ongoing prefetch of incremental speech audio chunks.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Cancels monitoring task for incremental prefetch.

methods.name: startIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring the prefetch status for upcoming segments.

methods.name: ensureIncrementalPrefetchForUpcomingSegment
methods.description: Ensures prefetch is initiated for upcoming speech segments.

methods.name: startIncrementalPreFetch
methods.description: Begins prefetching audio chunks for a speech segment via TTS API.

methods.name: completeIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Completes prefetch with gathered chunks.

methods.name: clearIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Clears prefetch state and cancels related task.

methods.name: failIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Handles failure of prefetch process.

methods.name: consumeIncrementalPrefetchedAudioIfAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves prefetched audio chunks if available for a segment.

methods.name: resolveIncrementalPrefetchOutputFormat
methods.description: Determines output format to use for incremental prefetch based on context.

methods.name: finishIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Finalizes incremental speech, flushing buffers and ending tasks.

methods.name: handleIncrementalAssistantFinal
methods.description: Handles the final incremental assistant text, prepping for playback.

methods.name: streamAssistant
methods.description: Streams assistant events from the gateway, working with incremental buffer.

methods.name: updateIncrementalContextIfNeeded
methods.description: Updates speech context if directives have changed.

methods.name: buildIncrementalSpeechContext
methods.description: Builds context for incremental TTS based on directives and settings.
